regime: Metals selling deepens while tech steadies on Nvidia
takeaway: Gold slipped below $3,800 for the first time since September 2025 and silver fell about 3%, a stronger drop than gold, as traders priced in a December Fed rate hike and the dollar held near a 19-month high; this matches the site's forced-selling-in-metals and silver-under-stress checks. Tech futures rose after Nvidia's results beat forecasts, while the VIX stayed elevated at about 25.5 from Tuesday. The Fed minutes at 11 AM PT are the next test for yields, the dollar and metals.
